notablePrerequisites:
Virtus does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Virtus.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Virtus.
Virtus triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
